lastChange.note: Round 4: new card DeskMap, home's map of every project, one lane each on a shared two-week axis; it opens large at the top of home and folds slim and pinned as you scroll, and what waits on the owner pops up on its lane in the StatusMark tint, tied to its row in Needs you. It replaces the project cards on home; ProjectCard is kept but no longer used there. The owner's rulings of 15 and 16 November 2026, decisions/questions/P-005-design-round-4.md, answers 6 to 8.
